# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $200

**Top pick: JBL Live 780NC.** RTINGS ranks it the best ANC pair under $200. Its noise cancelling rivals Sony and Bose flagships, and battery life is about 60 hours. It clamps fairly tight, so it may be uncomfortable on a larger head, and the mic is only okay. RTINGS says it sometimes dips just under $200, so check the current price. [RTINGS review and retailer prices](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Best value: Anker Soundcore Space Q45.** RTINGS calls it the best all-rounder under $200, at roughly $100. It handles engine rumble and street noise well and lasts about 28 hours with ANC on. Downsides are a slight hiss and some reports of hinge or headband breakage. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/by-price/under-200)

**Best for Android and a budget: Soundcore Space One.** It supports LDAC, has an 8-band EQ and lasts about 43 hours with ANC on. Dealectric lists it at $99.99, or $80 with code AFSC20 (tested 2026-10-22). [Buy link](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one). Dealectric earns a commission, and the code is entered at checkout. LDAC only helps if your phone supports it, so iPhone users won't get that benefit.

**Best step up: Soundcore Space One Pro.** Tom's Guide names it best under $200 and notes the soft ear cups. Dealectric lists it at $199.99, or $160 with AFSC20. [Buy link](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one-pro)

**Best for calls and strong ANC: Sony ULT WEAR (about $200).** SoundGuys measured more than 25 dB of cancellation above 80 Hz, and it has multipoint and LDAC. Battery is about 32 hours. RTINGS recommends it for calls. [RatingMobile summary](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Best sound: Sennheiser ACCENTUM Plus.** RTINGS likes its smooth, bassy tuning, parametric EQ and 56-hour battery. Its ANC is weaker than the JBL's or Anker's, and the headband is thinly padded. [RTINGS review](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Cheapest option: JLab JBuds Lux ANC (about $80).** It has a long battery life (about 40 hours with ANC on) and good sound for the price. However, SoundGuys measured the weakest ANC of the group at 10–20 dB below 700 Hz. [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/us/best-noise-cancelling-headphones%2Creview-5566.html)

## My recommendation
- **Strongest ANC for the money:** JBL Live 780NC or Sony ULT WEAR
- **Best balance of price and performance:** Soundcore Space Q45
- **Cheapest decent option:** Soundcore Space One at $80 with the code

I couldn't open retailer pages, so I don't have direct buy links for the JBL, Sony, Sennheiser and Q45. The RTINGS pages above list Amazon, Best Buy and Walmart prices for them. Prices change often, so confirm before buying.
